description: Blessed Textiles Limited was incorporated in September 1987 and operates under the common management of the Umer Group, with Bhanero Textile Mills Limited and Faisal Spinning Mills Limited as associated undertakings. It produces yarn and fabric for domestic consumption and international markets from two spinning units totalling 68,640 spindles and a weaving unit of 140 air-jet looms, all at Sheikhupura in Punjab.
headOffice: Umer House, Plot 23/1, Sector 23, S.M. Farooq Road, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
